Class UcumEssence

java.lang.Object
network.ike.foundation.ike.ucum.UcumEssence
All Implemented Interfaces:
UcumSymbols
public final class UcumEssence extends Object implements UcumSymbols
The unmodified UCUM file, read as it is: its prefixes, its base units, and its defined units, every code, name, symbol, property, class, and definition as the file writes them. Nothing is reworded; the only change to a text is that the file's line breaks and indentation inside an element are collapsed to single spaces. The file also answers the grammar's questions at import time, and reduces each unit to the base units by following its definition.

The file is Regenstrief Institute's, under the UCUM license; see the notices beside it (IKE-Network/ike-issues#1114).

    • reduction

      public UcumReduction reduction(String atomCode)
      Reduces an atom by following its definition down to the base units. A base unit is its own dimension at magnitude one. A defined unit is its definition's number times the reduction of its definition's unit. A special unit reduces through its function's value and unit and is flagged special; an arbitrary unit is flagged arbitrary; the flags follow into every unit defined in terms of a flagged one.
      Specified by:
      reduction in interface UcumSymbols
      Parameters:
      atomCode - the atom's code
      Returns:
      its reduction
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if no atom has that code
      IllegalStateException - if the file defines a unit in terms of itself
